---
title: "NFLMonteCarloSim2.0"
output: github_document
date: "2026-11-22"
---

```{r}
# ========================================================
# NFL Playoff Probabilities - HIGH PERFORMANCE VERSION Updated for Off vs Def match ups, individual team pace, and predictive penalties 1/15/26
# ========================================================
library(nflfastR)
library(nflseedR)
library(nflreadr)
library(dplyr)
library(future)

# 1) Load Data 
# --------------------------------------------------------
season_year <- 2026
pbp <- nflfastR::load_pbp(season_year)
games_raw <- nflreadr::load_schedules(seasons = season_year)

# 2) Define Stable Penalty Lists
# --------------------------------------------------------
stable_off_penalties <- c("False Start", "Offensive Holding", "Defensive Offside")
stable_def_penalties <- c("Defensive Offside", "Defensive Pass Interference")

# 3) Calculate Team Strength with Penalty Reversion
# --------------------------------------------------------
message("Calculating Penalty-Adjusted Team Strength...")

pbp_adjusted <- pbp |>
  filter(!is.na(epa), !is.na(wp), wp >= 0.05 & wp <= 0.95) |>
  mutate(
    # Identify penalized team (Standard nflfastR schema)
    is_off_penalty = ifelse(penalty == 1 & penalty_team == posteam, 1, 0),
    is_def_penalty = ifelse(penalty == 1 & penalty_team == defteam, 1, 0),
    
    # Logic: Keep observed EPA for stable flags, 0 (neutral) for unstable ones.
    adj_epa = case_when(
      # STABLE OFFENSE: Account for discipline or drawing offsides
      is_off_penalty == 1 & penalty_type %in% stable_off_penalties ~ epa,
      is_def_penalty == 1 & penalty_type == "Defensive Offside" ~ epa,
      
      # STABLE DEFENSE: Account for systematic aggressiveness (DPI)
      is_def_penalty == 1 & penalty_type %in% stable_def_penalties ~ epa,
      
      # UNSTABLE NOISE: Set to 0 (Reverts play to a "net zero" impact)
      penalty == 1 ~ 0,
      
      # CLEAN PLAYS: Keep original EPA
      TRUE ~ epa
    )
  )

# Separate Offense and Defense Efficiency
off_strength <- pbp_adjusted |>
  group_by(team = posteam) |>
  summarise(off_epa = mean(adj_epa, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

def_strength <- pbp_adjusted |>
  group_by(team = defteam) |>
  summarise(def_epa = mean(adj_epa, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Calculate Matchup Pace (Offensive tempo vs. Defensive plays allowed)
raw_pace_off <- pbp |>
  filter(play_type %in% c("pass", "run"), !is.na(posteam)) |>
  group_by(game_id, team = posteam) |>
  summarise(plays = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(team) |>
  summarise(off_pace = mean(plays, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

raw_pace_def <- pbp |>
  filter(play_type %in% c("pass", "run"), !is.na(defteam)) |>
  group_by(game_id, team = defteam) |>
  summarise(plays_allowed = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(team) |>
  summarise(def_pace = mean(plays_allowed, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Final Combined Table
team_strength <- off_strength |>
  inner_join(def_strength, by = "team") |>
  left_join(raw_pace_off, by = "team") |>
  left_join(raw_pace_def, by = "team") |>
  mutate(tot_epa = off_epa - def_epa) |>
  mutate(wt_tot_epa = 1.1 * off_epa - def_epa)

# 4) Vectorized Matchup-Specific Simulation Function
# --------------------------------------------------------
compute_epa_results_fast <- function(teams, games, week_num, ...) {
  args <- list(...)
  ts <- args$team_strength
  hfa_pts <- args$home_field_adv
  
  idx <- which(is.na(games$result) & games$week == week_num)
  if(length(idx) == 0) return(list(games = games, teams = teams))
  
  h_idx <- match(games$home_team[idx], ts$team)
  a_idx <- match(games$away_team[idx], ts$team)
  
  # Predict EPA/play with 1.1x weight for offensive stability
  h_exp_epa <- (1.1 * ts$off_epa[h_idx] + ts$def_epa[a_idx])
  a_exp_epa <- (1.1 * ts$off_epa[a_idx] + ts$def_epa[h_idx])
  
  # MATCHUP PACE LOGIC:
  # Home score = Home Offense Pace vs. Away Defense Pace Allowed
  h_matchup_plays <- (ts$off_pace[h_idx] + ts$def_pace[a_idx]) / 2
  # Away score = Away Offense Pace vs. Home Defense Pace Allowed
  a_matchup_plays <- (ts$off_pace[a_idx] + ts$def_pace[h_idx]) / 2
  
  # Calculate point expectations per side
  h_expected_pts <- h_exp_epa * h_matchup_plays
  a_expected_pts <- a_exp_epa * a_matchup_plays
  
  # Apply Home Field Advantage and Game-Level Noise
  game_noise_sd <- 13.7
  hfa_vec <- ifelse(games$location[idx] == "Neutral", 0, hfa_pts)
  
  expected_margin <- (h_expected_pts - a_expected_pts) + hfa_vec
  games$result[idx] <- rnorm(length(idx), mean = expected_margin, sd = game_noise_sd)
  
  return(list(games = games, teams = teams))
}

# 5) Simulation Execution
# --------------------------------------------------------
options(future.globals.maxSize = 1500 * 1024^2) 
plan(multisession, workers = 2)
set.seed(42)

message("Simulating 50k seasons with Matchup-Pace Logic...")

sim <- nflseedR::nfl_simulations(
  games = games_raw,
  compute_results = compute_epa_results_fast,
  team_strength = team_strength,
  home_field_adv = 1.9, 
  simulations = 50000,
  save_simulations = TRUE
)

plan(sequential)

# 6) Final Super Bowl Odds
# --------------------------------------------------------
playoff_odds <- sim$overall |>
  select(team, playoff, div1, seed1, won_conf, won_sb) %>%
  arrange(desc(won_sb))

print(playoff_odds)
```
